item.title: As the Tupac murder trial continues, a look back at the cultural moment
item.description: NPR's Juana Summers speaks with Joel Anderson, a host of the podcast Slow Burn, about the Tupac Shakur murder trial and the cultural moment around his murder.

item.title: Yahya Abdul-Mateen II has a theory about Marvel's 'Wonder Man' cancellation
item.description: Two weeks after being nominated for an Emmy for his leading role in Wonder Man, Abdul-Mateen found out that the series had been cancelled. He says Marvel could do more to support Black-led projects.

item.title: D.C.'s IndyCar race will zoom past museums. Some worry it could harm the art inside
item.description: Sunday's course takes high-speed cars right past the National Gallery of Art and three Smithsonian museums. Art experts worry about the works inside, but organizers say they don't expect damage.

item.title: Which country makes the best jollof rice? D.C. foodies put it to a blind test
item.description: One of the most famous dishes across West Africa is jollof rice — fragrant rice cooked down with spices, tomatoes and meat. But which version is best? A traveling festival aims to find out.

item.title: 'Shrinking' star Jason Segel isn't afraid to share the 'dirty underneath'
